verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help article confirms you can export a full general ledger and financial statements, on cash or accrual basis, in Excel, CSV and PDF, which covers the core accounting record in open formats. The story asks for all of your data, though, and the evidence shows only ledger and statement exports; the API is request-gated and not documented as an export path. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting other data (invoices, attachments, rules, chart of accounts, classes), a documented complete account export or offboarding process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Yes, you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
